description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing and rehabilitation facility in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader committed to delivering exceptional patient care and operational excellence.The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of facility management, ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. This role requires a leader who can drive quality outcomes, manage financial performance, and inspire a high-performing team.This full-time position offers a competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, commensurate with experience. If you are a proven leader looking to make a significant impact in a supportive environment, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities.
Proven track record of successful operational and financial management.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, based on experience.

description: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Orthopedic Surgeon to join a premier medical center in NYC, NY. This is an exceptional opportunity for a dedicated professional to contribute to a dynamic healthcare environment, focusing on patient care and surgical excellence. The role offers a competitive compensation package, with a strong emphasis on performance-based bonuses. We are looking for a surgeon who thrives in a challenging yet rewarding setting.The ideal candidate will possess a minimum of 5 years of experience in orthopedic surgery, with a specialized background in handling Workers' Compensation and No-Fault cases. This position is crucial for our continued commitment to providing top-tier orthopedic care to our community. If you are a board-certified or board-eligible Orthopedic Surgeon looking for a role where your expertise is valued and generously rewarded, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Medical Doctor (MD or DO) degree from an accredited institution
Board Certification or Board Eligibility in Orthopedic Surgery
Valid New York State medical license
Minimum of 5 years of experience as a practicing Orthopedic Surgeon
Demonstrated experience with Workers' Compensation and No-Fault cases
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $300,000 to $350,000 per year, with a significant emphasis on performance-based bonuses.
